nodes.text: 和平宣言：核风险对话+能源增产共识
nodes.text_en: Peace declaration: nuclear dialogue + energy production consensus

jargon.explain: 因为担心打仗，投资者要求额外回报才肯持有资产。一旦风险下降，这部分“恐惧折扣”被去掉，资产价格就跳涨。
jargon.explain_en: Extra return investors demand for holding assets when they fear conflict. Once risk falls, this 'fear discount' is removed and prices jump.

jargon.explain: 三个核大国联合声明“核战争打不赢也打不得”，并承诺能源稳定供应。等于给市场发了一张“短期内不会发生最坏情况”的保险单。
jargon.explain_en: Three nuclear powers jointly declare 'nuclear war cannot be won and must not be fought', promising stable energy supply. Essentially an insurance policy against worst-case scenarios.

jargon.explain: 投资者是更愿意买股票（风险资产）还是买国债（避险资产）的倾向。今天明显转向前者。
jargon.explain_en: Whether investors prefer stocks (risk assets) or bonds (safe havens). Today clearly shifted to the former.

jargon.explain: AI公司花在买芯片、建数据中心、租GPU上的钱。Anthropic融了1073亿，大部分会变成硬件采购订单，直接利好半导体公司。
jargon.explain_en: Money AI companies spend on chips, data centers, and GPUs. Anthropic raised $107.3B, most becomes hardware purchase orders, directly benefiting semiconductor companies.

jargon.explain: 数据中心里用光（而不是电）传输数据的技术。AI集群越大，需要的光模块、光缆就越多，Coherent/Lumentum这些公司就是卖这个的。
jargon.explain_en: Technology using light (not electricity) to transmit data in data centers. The bigger the AI cluster, the more optical modules and cables needed. Coherent/Lumentum sell these.

jargon.explain: IPO正式挂牌前在场外进行的私下交易。Anthropic暗盘涨20%，说明机构投资者在正式交易前就抢着买，预期很高。
jargon.explain_en: Off-exchange trading before official IPO listing. Anthropic grey market +20% shows institutions are buying eagerly before formal trading, indicating high expectations.

nodes.text: 伊朗革命卫队在霍尔木兹海峡布雷
油价方向待定（取决于事态升级与否）

jargon.explain: 全球约20%的石油运输必经之路。谁控制了这里，就抓住了全球能源的咽咙。在这里布雷等于在高速公路上放钉子。
jargon.explain_en: About 20% of global oil transport passes through here. Whoever controls it holds the world's energy throat. Mining here is like putting nails on a highway.

jargon.explain: 能装200万桶原油的巨型油轮。两艘触雷意味着400万桶原油运输受阻，相当于一个小产油国一天的产量。
jargon.explain_en: Giant tanker carrying 2M barrels of crude. Two hitting mines means 4M barrels of transport disrupted, equivalent to a small producer's daily output.

jargon.explain: 中俄美宣言中提到“计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应”。如果三方真的协调增产，可以在一定程度上弥补海峡中断的供应——但执行细节还不清楚。
jargon.explain_en: China-Russia-US declaration mentions 'planning to increase refined petroleum production and supply'. If coordinated, could partially offset strait disruption—but execution details unclear.

nodes.text: 阿里云外部收入增速64%（超预期）
市场质疑：收入增长能否覆盖基础设施投入？
nodes.text_en: Market questions: can revenue cover infrastructure spending?

jargon.explain: 公司花在买设备、建厂房、买芯片上的钱。阿里一个季度花了505亿，说明在疯狂建数据中心——收入在涨，但花的钱涨得更快。
jargon.explain_en: Money spent on equipment, facilities, and chips. Alibaba spent 50.5B in one quarter, frantically building data centers—revenue is growing, but spending grows faster.

jargon.explain: 赚的钱减去必须花的钱后，真正“落袋”的现金。阿里自由现金流净流出345亿，意味着这个季度是“花得比赚得多”。
jargon.explain_en: Earnings minus mandatory spending, the actual 'pocketed' cash. Alibaba's FCF outflow of 34.5B means spending exceeded earnings this quarter.

jargon.explain: 连续13个季度AI相关产品收入增速超过100%。这在任何行业都是极罕见的，说明AI需求确实在爆发——问题是赚的钱够不够覆盖投入。
jargon.explain_en: AI-related product revenue growth exceeding 100% for 13 consecutive quarters. Extremely rare in any industry, confirming AI demand is exploding—the question is whether earnings cover the investment.

nodes.text: 欧央行管委Kocher：可能需要进一步加息
nodes.text_en: ECB's Kocher: may need further rate hikes

nodes.text: 市场上调欧央行终点利率预期
nodes.text_en: Market raises ECB terminal rate expectations

nodes.text: 法国央行行长Moulin：法国不能忽视高债务
nodes.text_en: France central bank's Moulin: France cannot ignore high debt

nodes.text: 法德国债利差走阔风险

jargon.explain: 央行官员倾向于加息、收紧货币政策来压制通胀的态度。Kocher说“可能需要进一步加息”就是典型的鹰派信号。
jargon.explain_en: Central bank officials' tendency to raise rates and tighten monetary policy to suppress inflation. Kocher saying 'may need further hikes' is a classic hawkish signal.

jargon.explain: 两个国家国债收益率的差额。如果法国债务风险上升，投资者会要求更高的回报才肯买法国国债，法德利差就会走阔——这是欧洲危机的经典预警信号。
jargon.explain_en: Yield difference between two countries' government bonds. If France's debt risk rises, investors demand higher returns for French bonds, widening the French-German spread—a classic European crisis warning signal.

jargon.explain: 市场预期央行加息到哪个水平就会停。如果Kocher暗示还要加，终点利率预期就上移，欧元升值，因为持有欧元资产能获得更高的利息回报。
jargon.explain_en: The rate level at which the market expects the central bank to stop hiking. If Kocher hints at more hikes, terminal rate expectations rise and the Euro appreciates, as Euro assets offer higher interest returns.

TPI（传导保护工具）使用条件：Moulin称“法国尚未满足欧央行动用工具的条件”——说明目前风险仍可控，但若条件被触发，等同于危机信号
vars_en: French-German 10Y spread: currently ~75bp. If widens to 85bp+, market starts pricing 'France fiscal loss of control' risk
Eurozone labor costs: Q3 preliminary 3.5% (prev 3.1%), rising wages are core inflation's 'last mile'. If continues higher, ECB will indeed hike

historical_analogies.event: 雷曼兄弟破产 + AIG救助（2008年9月）
historical_analogies.lesson: 当市场为单一公司IPO狂欢时（Anthropic 1073亿），不要忘记2008年雷曼破产前市场也在为“金融创新永动机”定价。巨量融资不等于盈利验证——系统脆弱性往往在最乐观时暴露。
historical_analogies.lesson_en: When markets celebrate a single company's IPO (Anthropic $107.3B), remember that before Lehman's collapse in 2008, markets were also pricing in a 'financial innovation perpetual motion machine'. Massive funding ≠ profitability validation—system fragility often surfaces at peak optimism.
historical_analogies.diff: 2008年的风险藏在衍生品不透明链条里；今天AI公司的资产负债表相对透明（阿里Capex数据公开可查）。且AI基础设施投入有明确的终端需求（企业用AI），不像CDO的底层资产是次贷。
historical_analogies.diff_en: 2008's risk was hidden in opaque derivative chains; today's AI companies have relatively transparent balance sheets (Alibaba's Capex data is public). AI infrastructure investment has clear end-user demand (enterprise AI), unlike CDOs backed by subprime mortgages.

historical_analogies.event: 两伊战争期间的“油轮战”（1984-1988年）
historical_analogies.lesson: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮遭袭并非首次。1980年代两伊战争期间，双方互相袭击油轮，导致油价短期飙升后又被全球协调护航机制压制。今天的伊朗革命卫队布雷事件，可能在复制“有限升级→国际协调→风险消退”的剧本。
historical_analogies.lesson_en: Hormuz tanker attacks aren't unprecedented. During the 1980s Iran-Iraq War, both sides attacked tankers, causing oil prices to spike then subside through globally coordinated escort mechanisms. Today's IRGC mining may replicate the 'limited escalation → international coordination → risk subsiding' script.
historical_analogies.diff: 1980年代没有“中俄美联合宣言”这种三方协调机制。如果三国增产共识真正落地，即使海峡发生局部冲突，全球能源供应的兖底能力比当年强得多。但伊朗的无人机/水雷技术也远超当年。
historical_analogies.diff_en: The 1980s lacked a 'China-Russia-US joint declaration' coordination mechanism. If the three-nation production consensus materializes, even with localized strait conflict, global energy supply resilience is far stronger. But Iran's drone/mine technology is also far superior.

historical_analogies.event: 欧债危机：希腊-意大利-西班牙利差螺旋（2011-2012年）
historical_analogies.event_en: European Debt Crisis: Greece-Italy-Spain spread spiral (2011-2012)
historical_analogies.lesson: 欧央行管委今天同时发出“需要加息”（Kocher）和“法国债务不能忽视”（Moulin）的信号——这与2011年欧央行在通胀压力下过早加息、随后引爆意大利债务螺旋的剧本高度相似。加息+高债务=火药桶。
historical_analogies.lesson_en: ECB officials simultaneously signaling 'need to hike' (Kocher) and 'France cannot ignore debt' (Moulin) today—this closely mirrors the 2011 script when the ECB raised rates prematurely under inflation pressure, then triggered Italy's debt spiral. Rate hikes + high debt = powder keg.
historical_analogies.diff: 2012年Draghi的“whatever it takes”承诺和OMT/PEPP/TPI等工具箱今天已存在。Moulin明确说“法国尚未满足动用工具的条件”，说明央行自己也在监控这条线。但工具存在不等于能无成本使用——政治博弈才是关键。
historical_analogies.diff_en: Draghi's 2012 'whatever it takes' pledge and tools like OMT/PEPP/TPI now exist. Moulin explicitly says 'France does not yet meet tool activation conditions', showing the ECB is monitoring this line. But tool existence ≠ cost-free usage—political gaming is the key.

historical_analogies.event: 2000年互联网泡沫：Capex暴增先于盈利崩塌（1999-2001年）
historical_analogies.event_en: Dot-com bubble: Capex surge preceded profit collapse (1999-2001)
historical_analogies.lesson: 阿里Capex单季505亿、自由现金流净流出345亿——这与2000年电信公司疯狂铺设光缆、随后盈利无法覆盖投入的剧本如出一辙。当“增长故事”遇到“现金流现实”，往往是叙事拐点。
historical_analogies.lesson_en: Alibaba's quarterly Capex of 50.5B and FCF outflow of 34.5B—this mirrors the 2000 telecom companies frantically laying fiber, then profits failing to cover investment. When a 'growth story' meets 'cash flow reality', it's often a narrative turning point.
historical_analogies.diff: 2000年铺设的光缆后来确实被用了，只是用了5-10年才回本。AI基础设施的变现周期可能更短（阿里云收入已经在三位数增长），但“收入增长”和“自由现金流转正”之间的gap仍然巨大。关键区别在于这次有真实的B端付费需求在支撑，不像当年很多流量是免费的。
historical_analogies.diff_en: The fiber laid in 2000 was eventually used, just took 5-10 years to break even. AI infrastructure monetization may be faster (Alibaba Cloud revenue already growing at triple digits), but the gap between 'revenue growth' and 'FCF breakeven' remains huge. The key difference is real B-side paid demand exists this time, unlike the free traffic of the dot-com era.
